WITH order_invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    COUNT(*) as invoice_count
  FROM Invoices
  GROUP BY order_id
),
total_invoice_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices
  FROM order_invoice_counts
),
order_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    o.invoice_count,
    CAST(o.invoice_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total_invoices FROM total_invoice_count) as share
  FROM order_invoice_counts o
),
avg_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM order_shares
),
above_avg_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    o.invoice_count,
    o.share
  FROM order_shares o
  WHERE o.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value)) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg_orders
